headline: Take-Two Interactive Stock Advances Following Rating Announcement for GTA VI
summary: Take-Two Interactive shares rose on Wall Street after rating classifications for Grand Theft Auto VI were released ahead of its scheduled launch.
why: Take-Two Interactive is a major American video game publisher known for the Grand Theft Auto franchise.

impacts.name: Take-Two Interactive
impacts.why: Official age rating steps reinforce investor confidence in scheduled game release milestones.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Rating confirmations for Grand Theft Auto VI fueled investor expectations for upcoming commercial revenues.
